entity_kinds.description: A Blender scene containing collections and objects

entity_kinds.label: Modifier
entity_kinds.description: A non-destructive operation in an object's modifier stack, evaluated top to bottom

result.description: Select an object and make it the active object, so that the Properties editor shows it.

target.description: Ref of an object, e.g. blender://object/Cube

ui_path.text: Click “${label:params.target}” in the 3D viewport or in the Outliner

result.description: Switch the Properties editor to a tab: MODIFIER (blue wrench), MATERIAL, OBJECT or DATA.

ui_path.text: In the Properties editor, click the ${params.tab} tab icon

title.en: Move, rotate or scale an object

result.description: Set an object's location (metres), rotation (degrees, XYZ Euler) or scale (1 = original size) to exact [x, y, z] values. To make an object bigger, multiply its current scale (see its props). Values are rounded to 3 decimals (1 for rotation).

target.description: Ref of an object, e.g. blender://object/Cube

ui_path.text: Select “${label:params.target}” in the 3D viewport or the Outliner
In the Properties editor, open the Object tab (orange square)
Under Transform, type ${params.value} into the ${params.property} fields

result.description: Add a modifier to an object. Common types: SUBSURF (Subdivision Surface), BEVEL, SOLIDIFY, MIRROR, ARRAY, DECIMATE, WIREFRAME, SMOOTH, TRIANGULATE.

target.description: Ref of an object, e.g. blender://object/Cube

ui_path.text: Select “${label:params.target}” in the 3D viewport or the Outliner
Open the Properties editor and click the blue wrench tab (Modifiers)
Click Add Modifier, pick the category, then choose ${params.type}

result.description: Set one property of a modifier (for example levels of SUBSURF, segments or width of BEVEL, thickness of SOLIDIFY). The property names are the keys under `props` of the modifier entity.

target.description: Ref of a modifier, e.g. blender://object/Cube/modifier/Bevel

ui_path.text: In the Modifiers tab, find the “${label:params.target}” panel
Set ${params.property} to ${params.value}

result.description: Move a modifier to another position in the stack. Index 0 is evaluated first. Order changes the result.

target.description: Ref of a modifier, e.g. blender://object/Cube/modifier/Bevel

ui_path.text: In the Modifiers tab, drag the grip (⠿) of “${label:params.target}” to position ${params.index}

result.description: Turn a modifier on or off in the 3D viewport (which=viewport, the monitor icon) or in final renders (which=render, the camera icon). The modifier stays in the stack; only its effect is switched. Current values are `show_viewport` and `show_render` under `props` of the modifier entity.

target.description: Ref of a modifier, e.g. blender://object/Cube/modifier/Bevel

ui_path.text: In the Modifiers tab, find the “${label:params.target}” panel
In its header, click the monitor icon (viewport) or the camera icon (render) to set ${params.which} to ${params.value}

result.description: Put an existing material (by name, see the material entities) on an object's first material slot. A slot is added when the object has none. The action never creates materials.

target.description: Ref of an object, e.g. blender://object/Cube

ui_path.text: Select “${label:params.target}” in the 3D viewport or the Outliner
In the Properties editor, open the Material tab
Click the browse-material button next to the slot and pick “${params.material}”

result.description: Delete a modifier from an object's stack.

target.description: Ref of a modifier, e.g. blender://object/Cube/modifier/Bevel

ui_path.text: In the Modifiers tab, find “${label:params.target}”
Click the small arrow in its header and choose Delete (or press Ctrl+X over it)

result.description: Apply a modifier: its effect is baked into the mesh and the modifier disappears. Wysp cannot undo this.

target.description: Ref of a modifier, e.g. blender://object/Cube/modifier/Bevel

ui_path.text: In the Modifiers tab, open the arrow menu in the header of “${label:params.target}”
Choose Apply (or hover the panel and press Ctrl+A). This bakes it into the mesh
